records.text: An anonymous source claimed that after Egyptian plane SU-BTT landed in a federally monitored hangar, a foreign dignitary was discreetly moved to 920 King Street
records.speaker: Satys and Egyptian-aircraft source (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: And don't forget that that same core, that same source claimed that after our Egyptian plane, tail number SUBTT, landed into this federally monitored hangar, a foreign dignitary was then discreetly moved to 920 King Street

verification.notes: This claim about an Egyptian plane (tail number SUBTT) landing at a federally monitored hangar and a foreign dignitary being moved to 920 King Street cannot be verified through public sources. No search results confirm the existence of 920 King Street as a location housing DEA, FBI, and Secret Service offices. The specific flight details, tail number, and dignitary movement are not publicly verifiable. The claim appears to reference specific surveillance or intelligence information that is not available in public records.
